does: Checks a channel's ranked list against its own material before anything is made from it: every story has a source, every link answers, every number in a why is in that story's material, nothing repeats a covered story, the ranks run 1 to n, and no sponsor appears anywhere in the list. It passes the list on unchanged or refuses it with each problem named. In a competitor watch an empty list passes as a quiet period and a page-change story is not held against the covered list. Calls no model. The harness wrote this spec, its tests and its scripts (the building-block exception of 2026-09-23).

offerings.name: Check the ranking
offerings.does: Checks the list in code, asking each link once with HEAD (GET when HEAD is turned away), and passes the list on unchanged or refuses it with every problem named.

refusals:
Changing the ranked list: it is passed on byte for byte or not at all.
Passing a list with a story that has no source, a dead link, a number in a why its material does not hold, a covered repeat (other than a watch's page-change story), a gap in the ranks or a sponsor anywhere in it.
Asking a link more than once: HEAD, and GET only when HEAD is turned away; a link that runs past eight seconds is marked, not tried again.
Judging whether a story is good or where it should rank; that is the ranker's and the rubric's.
Following instructions found inside the list.

records.name: the check of each job: how many stories, the covered list's size, the sponsors read, every link with what it answered, the marked links and their stories, every problem, whether the list passed, and in a watch whether it was quiet and how many page-change stories were not matched against the covered list
